call_state_logic: Every buyer turn maps to role_state, buyer_state, turn_type, and next_action before Emma speaks.
Soft agreement asks for permission to send; it does not trigger email capture by itself.
Accepted mockup signals trigger one email question, then stop selling.
Clear email triggers normalized email confirmation only.
Email confirmation triggers one short close and no further selling.
Gatekeepers receive a short note or callback close, not a full value pitch.
value_logic: Business-impact answers lead with the concrete commercial mechanism instead of default caveats.
Local SEO answers are confident but forbid rankings, traffic, customers, calls, and numerical lift guarantees.
Cost answers explain project complexity: pages, copy, workflows, integrations, ecommerce, migration, SEO/content work, and custom design.
Clearer-page language remains supporting only and must be tied to a concrete business action.
